xSearch - Deployment

xSearch is compiled into your Clarion application. There is no separate xSearch runtime DLL to deploy.

The tag and search icons used by the template are included in the compiled program rather than deployed as separate runtime files. They must be available at build time; see the complete icon and image inventory in Installation.

For source and installer staging, icons live in Source/Images and must be installed to accessory\images. The legacy manifest file Source/Lib/winxpmnf.res is installed to accessory\lib\win; it is not an image and does not belong in libsrc\win.

Deploy your Clarion application normally, including any DLLs that are part of your own application. For persisted search/export preferences, set the global INI file to a writable filename or a runtime variable containing that filename. A bare name resolves beside the EXE; applications installed under Program Files will generally need a writable location elsewhere. See INI Files and Remembered Settings.
